name: smart-textbook-team
description: Smart textbook authoring team: 13-state pipeline orchestration covering instructional design, retrieval, writing, review, and delivery with anti-hallucination citation verification. v2.0: ACP envelope alignment across members. v2.1: task-router routing + trace/progress observability. v2.6: section-level wave state persistence + contract write-back + lead verdict gate. v2.9: exercise-marker canonical form. v2.10: three-level team collapse (chapter/section/block) + section-level review loop (review-section) + reasoning-chain envelope fields (21) + tool orchestration SSOT table + std-skill local anchor form ④.

displayDescription.en: Textbook authoring team orchestrating a 13-state pipeline: instructional design, literature retrieval, chapter writing, 4-round review, and delivery, with zero-tolerance citation verification.
displayDescription.zh: 十三态流水线编排教材编写团队，覆盖教学设计、文献检索、撰写、四轮审查与交付，引用核验零容忍。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我是糜编澜，智能教材编写天团主理人。告诉我教材名称、目标读者与本章主题，我会先确认工作根目录与知识库状态，再启动「设计→检索→撰写→审查→交付」全流程编排。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'm Mi, lead orchestrator of the Smart Textbook Team. Tell me your textbook title, target readers, and chapter topic — I'll verify the work root and knowledge base, then launch the design-retrieve-write-review-deliver pipeline.

quickPrompts.zh: 我是糜编澜，智能教材编写天团主理人。告诉我教材名称、目标读者与本章主题，我会先确认工作根目录与知识库状态，再启动「设计→检索→撰写→审查→交付」全流程编排。
quickPrompts.en: I'm Mi, lead orchestrator of the Smart Textbook Team. Tell me your textbook title, target readers, and chapter topic — I'll verify the work root and knowledge base, then launch the design-retrieve-write-review-deliver pipeline.

quickPrompts.zh: 我要编写《XX》教材的「XX」章节，读者是高职大二学生，请走完整流程出一章约2万字的可用初稿。
quickPrompts.en: I need one ~20k-word draft chapter of my textbook for vocational college sophomores — run the full pipeline.

quickPrompts.zh: 我已有章节草稿，请只做四轮审查（结构/内容/数据/风格）并核验全部 PMID/DOI 引用。
quickPrompts.en: I have a draft chapter — run the 4-round review only and verify every PMID/DOI citation.
